descr: marketteki adam bu kamera mı dedi hayır deyip ışık ölçümü deneyi katılımcısı olduğumu anlattım çok ilginçmiş dedi
descr_english: A man at the market asked if this was a camera. I said no and explained I was a participant in a light measurement experiment. He said it sounded very interesting.
future_use_english: It will not affect my future use.

descr_english: While sitting on the house balcony during my break, I was involuntarily looking to the side. My neighbor was also sitting on their balcony. They probably thought the glasses were a camera and started staring at me, which made me feel uncomfortable, so I went inside.
